species.name: Crumcone
dex_pages: It folds a cone @ round warm treats @ to guard crumbs.
Its paper arms @ pinch lost cookies @ before they fall.
species.visual_theme: A tall white paper cone with one diagonal fold, a face on the white front panel, tiny paper-fold feet and an overflowing heap of chocolate-chip cookies. One curled cookie recalls Doughlin.

species.name: Pailbaron
dex_pages: Its white bucket @ holds a warm heap @ of stolen cookies.
The handle swings @ to guard its stash @ from hungry paws.
species.visual_theme: A broad white pail body with a white rolled rim and high white arching handle. Its face sits directly on the pail beneath the overflowing cookies; crescent-cookie clamps and broad paper feet give a heavy final silhouette.
